segments.pv39:1.3: Nessāma taṃ yattha thunanti duggatā, samappitā [samajjatā (sī.)] nerayikā dukhenā”ti.
segments.pv39:2.1: Icceva [iccevaṃ (syā. ka.)] vatvāna yamassa dūtā, te dve yakkhā lohitakkhā brahantā;
segments.pv39:2.3: Paccekabāhāsu gahetvā revataṃ, pakkāmayuṃ devagaṇassa santike.
segments.pv39:4.3: Taṃ dissati suriyasamānavaṇṇaṃ, ko modati saggapatto vimāne”ti.
segments.pv39:5.1: “Bārāṇasiyaṃ nandiyo nāmāsi, upāsako amaccharī dānapati vadaññū;
segments.pv39:6.3: Taṃ dissati suriyasamānavaṇṇaṃ, so modati saggapatto vimāne”ti.
segments.pv39:7.3: Bhattu vimāne ramissāmi dānahaṃ, na patthaye nirayadassanāyā”ti.
segments.pv39:8.1: “Eso te nirayo supāpadhamme, puññaṃ tayā akataṃ jīvaloke;
segments.pv39:8.3: Na hi maccharī rosako pāpadhammo, saggūpagānaṃ labhati sahabyatan”ti.
segments.pv39:11.1: “Kiṃ nu kāyena vācāya, manasā dukkaṭaṃ kataṃ;
segments.pv39:12.3: Musāvādena vañcesi, taṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ tayā.
segments.pv39:14.1: “Hatthepi chindanti athopi pāde, kaṇṇepi chindanti athopi nāsaṃ;
segments.pv39:14.3: Athopi kākoḷagaṇā samecca, saṅgamma khādanti viphandamānan”ti.
segments.pv39:15.1: “Sādhu kho maṃ paṭinetha, kāhāmi kusalaṃ bahuṃ;
segments.pv39:15.5: Yaṃ katvā sukhitā honti, na ca pacchānutappare”ti.
segments.pv39:17.1: “Ko devalokato manussalokaṃ, gantvāna puṭṭho me evaṃ vadeyya;
segments.pv39:17.5: Na hi maccharī rosako pāpadhammo, saggūpagānaṃ labhati sahabyataṃ’.
segments.pv39:18.1: “Sāhaṃ nūna ito gantvā, yoniṃ laddhāna mānusiṃ;
segments.pv39:21.3: Na ca dāne pamajjissaṃ, sāmaṃ diṭṭhamidaṃ mayā”ti.
segments.pv39:23.3: Vitathena ca sāmikaṃ vañcayitvā, paccāmahaṃ niraye ghorarūpe”ti.

lines: Taṃ yasmā revatīvimānavatthunā nibbisesaṃ, tasmā yadettha aṭṭhuppattiyaṃ gāthāsu ca vattabbaṃ, taṃ paramatthadīpaniyaṃ vimānavatthuvaṇṇanāyaṃ (vi. va. aṭṭha.860 revatīvimānavaṇṇanā) vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ.
Idañhi nandiyassa devaputtassa vasena vimānavatthupāḷiyaṃ saṅgahaṃ āropitampi revatīpaṭibaddhāya gāthāya vasena “revatīpetavatthun”ti petavatthupāḷiyampi saṅgahaṃ āropitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
